Emma (Partnerships): Nimbus sent a small update to the co-brand assets. Folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nimbus_update
Mike (Design): Seeing new banners but only high-compression PNGs. Need SVGs and the mono logo variant.
Olivia (Partner PM): Asked Nimbus for SVG/EPS + color hexes; they said they'll upload by EOD.
nimbus-upload-bot: file uploaded: /assets/nimbus_banner_pack_v4.zip
Sarah (Legal): Quick flag: the FR case study had a sentence implying 'data hosted in FR'  we need that removed or qualified. Also check translated customer quotes permission.
Raj (Marketing): For marketplace copy, let's use our usual phrasing: 'production-grade inference'. I'll propose two short headline variants and post them here.
Mike (Design): I'll prepare a co-brand preview with clearspace and accessible alt-text examples once I have vectors.
Emma (Partnerships): OK timeline: Nimbus vectors by EOD, Legal to confirm translations by tomorrow morning, marketing copy ready by midday. Ping me if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
